annotations.title: Get ready-to-apply fixes for a website

description: Checks one public website (up to 5 pages, read-only requests) and returns ready-to-apply fixes for what the check found: Organization JSON-LD, an llms.txt file, an AI-crawler section to add to the site's own robots.txt, missing meta description tags and Open Graph image tags. Each file comes with where it goes and plain-English steps. Files are made only for checks that failed; business details come from the site's own pages or from the optional facts, and anything not known is left as a visible placeholder to fill in.

facts.description: Optional public business details to put in the files, used in place of what the pages show. Not stored.

description.description: One or two sentences on what the business does

url.description: The public website address to fix (e.g. https://example.com)

name: get_fix_pack
title: Get ready-to-apply fixes for a website
